user, 2026-10-05: approved the brand reading in advance, no field-level answers

name.note: The name in the page metadata, the logo and the footer; the legal form ApS stays off document headers.

colors.primary.note: The site's named brand red, on the main button, the links and in the logo itself.

colors.secondary.note: The site's named mustard, used as the full-width band behind How we work and on button hover.

colors.foreground.note: The site's text colour, a near-black that also draws the word fieldwork in the logo.

typography.body.note: The site's body typeface, an open Google font, embedded in documents.

typography.heading.note: The site's heading typeface, an open Google font, embedded in documents.

typography.headingWeight.note: Headings on the site are set semibold (600), not bold.

logo.note: The mark from the site header that links home: four red squares, fieldwork in ink and digital in red.

voice.register.value: plain, concrete studio English: we-voice, short sentences, numbers instead of adjectives, promises stated as facts

voice.sample.value: Order sync is two days behind plan because the ERP export drops customer price lists over 500 lines. We have a fix in test and expect it live on Thursday. If it slips, you will hear it from us first.

notes.name: We took Fieldwork Digital from the page metadata, the logo and the footer, and leave the ApS for contracts and invoices.
notes.logo: This is the mark from your site header, kept in its own red and ink; its lettering is live text rather than outlines, so an outlined version of the file would make it render exactly the same everywhere.
notes.tone: Documents talk the way the homepage does: we, short sentences, the number instead of the adjective, and bad news told early and plainly.
